rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a broad, administrable Section 230 holding that algorithmic ranking and recommendations are publisher functions when they operate on third-party content, with Roommates.com limited to cases where the platform materially develops the unlawful aspect of the content. A Sotomayor dissent is likely to emphasize “affirmative steering” and real-world amplification harms, while one or more concurrences may stress textualism and/or note that Taamneh and ATA/JASTA provide the proper limiting principles for terrorism-related claims.
